meta.title: End price above the L1 sum total
gaps: Reproduce the closed RFQ setup with two bids (A 100 and B 90) and independently verify an L1 sum total of 900; the prepared state has exactly one vendor, one line item, and one bid.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Reproduce the closed RFQ setup with two bids (A 100 and B 90) and independently verify an L1 sum total of 900; the prepared state has exactly one vendor, one line item, and one bid.

plan.title: Reject auction end price above RFQ L1

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ summary as the required first step.
Open the RFQ stage Settings menu to reach the conversion action.
Convert the published closed RFQ into the auction configuration screen.

args.goal: On the converted auction create screen, continue past the conversion options, set the auction end price to a value above 900, click Publish, and verify that publishing is refused with the message "End price cannot be more than the lowest RFQ (L1) Sum Total".

steps.note: The catalog has no dedicated step for the converted auction end-price field or its publish refusal, so perform and verify that buyer-side interaction on screen.
